addressId.description: Foreign key to the specific address/suite the tenant occupies within the property, for multi-address properties.

expirationReason.description: Reason the occupancy ended (e.g. lease expiration, relocation), explaining tenant move-out and informing rollover analysis.

fromDate.description: Start date of the occupancy period; when the tenant's occupancy of the space begins, used for tenancy timelines and absorption.

id.description: Unique identifier of the tenant-occupancy record, representing one company's occupancy of space in a property over a date range.

industryType.description: Industry/business classification of the occupying tenant; for unknown tenants it captures the business type when the company is not yet identified.

leaseDeal.description: The associated lease-deal record carrying the negotiated lease terms (rent, dates, escalations, concessions) for this occupancy when a lease comp exists.

leaseType.description: Lease arrangement governing the occupancy (direct lease, sublease, owner-occupied). For leasing-activity rollups Direct = relet + new space and Sublet = sublet + assignment space; owner leases of their own buildings are excluded.

moveInDate.description: Date the tenant physically moved into the space (occupancy event). Drives net/gross absorption — absorption is counted from move-in events on occupied space, not the lease sign date.

propertyId.description: Foreign key to the property in which the tenant occupies space; anchors the occupancy to the building.

spaces.description: Collection of occupied-space records detailing the specific spaces/suites and square footage the tenant occupies within the property.

tenantLocationId.description: Foreign key to the Location (company node) that is the tenant occupying the space; null for an unknown/unidentified tenant.

toDate.description: End date of the occupancy period; null while the tenant is still in place. Distinguishes current versus historical occupancies and rollover timing.

askingRate.description: Lessor's quoted asking rent for the space as a low/high per-SF range with rate basis; the asking rent flavor, distinct from contract and effective.

askingRatePerMonth.description: Asking rent expressed as a per-month total; mutually exclusive with the per-year and per-SF forms, set when an asking amount is entered.

askingRatePerYear.description: Asking rent expressed as a per-year total; mutually exclusive with the per-month and per-SF forms, set when an asking amount is entered.

breakDates.description: Collection of UK lease break dates at which the tenant may terminate early; rollover-risk inputs. State exposed separately via breakDatesState.

breakDatesState.description: For the UK break-dates collection (early-exit points) on the lease.

businessRatesPerYear.description: Annual UK business rates (occupier property tax levied by the local authority) payable on the leased premises; a tenant occupancy cost shown on the Lease Comps financial terms as $/SF/Year.

commencementDate.description: Date the lease term begins; anchors term, free-rent and escalation schedules and is derived from sign or move-in date for renewals.

concessions.description: Collection of landlord concession records (TI allowances, free rent, other inducements) granted to the tenant that lower effective rent.

contacts.description: Collection of contacts on the deal (landlord/leasing-company and tenant representatives).

effectiveRate.description: User-entered effective rent per SF: NPV of net lease payments less TIA and other concessions, amortized over the term. The effective-rent flavor (never mix with asking or contract); can be negative when concessions exceed base rent.

effectiveRateBasis.description: Time basis (monthly/yearly) of the user-entered effective rate, needed to normalize effective rent to a common basis.

effectiveRateCalculatedBasis.description: Time basis of the system-calculated effective rate, populated from the effective-rent calculation result rather than user entry.

effectiveRatePerMonth.description: User-entered effective rent expressed as a per-month total, the per-month form of the concession-and-escalation-adjusted effective rent.

effectiveRatePerYear.description: User-entered effective rent expressed as a per-year total, the per-year form of the concession-and-escalation-adjusted effective rent.

expansionOptionComment.description: Free-text comment describing the expansion-option terms.

expansionOptionDate.description: Date the tenant may exercise the expansion option.

expansionOptionSquareFeet.description: Square footage covered by the tenant's expansion option.

expansionOptionState.description: Whether the tenant holds an option to expand into additional space.

expirationDate.description: Date the lease term ends, derived from commencement date plus lease term (or earliest off-market sublet space).

freeMonths.description: Number of free-rent (abated) months granted as a concession; an inducement that lowers effective rent. Displayed as 'XX Months at Start/End' or 'XX Months Total, Varying'. In the UK methodology free months are taken net of the 3-month fit-out period.

freeRentMethodType.description: Method of applying free rent (e.g. months at start versus a detailed schedule), set automatically from free months and the schedule.

freeRentSchedule.description: Collection of free-rent schedule entries detailing which lease months carry free or discounted rent; a concession schedule feeding effective-rent calculation.

grossAggregateValue.description: Total gross value of the lease deal over its term before concessions; an aggregate deal-value figure used to size the transaction.

id.description: Unique identifier of the lease deal (lease comp) record; the negotiated terms of an executed or pending lease.

isLeaseTermMonthToMonth.description: Whether the lease runs month-to-month rather than for a fixed term, indicating an open-ended tenancy.

leaseDealSourceType.description: Code indicating the source/origin classification of the lease deal data (where the deal information came from).

leaseDealType.description: Type of lease deal (e.g. new lease, renewal); renewal drives different commencement-date derivation than new/relet deals.

leaseTerm.description: Length of the lease in leaseTermType units; the duration of the lease obligation, used to derive expiration and validate schedules.

leaseTerminationOptionDate.description: Date the tenant may exercise an early lease-termination option.

leaseTerminationOptionPenalty.description: Free-text description of the penalty owed for exercising the early-termination option.

leaseTerminationOptionState.description: Whether the tenant holds an early-termination (break) option.

leaseTermType.description: Unit in which the lease term is expressed (days, months, years); combined with leaseTerm to compute term length in months.

marketEffectiveRate.description: System-calculated market effective rent per SF from the effective-rent engine — base/contract rent net of concessions, TIA and free rent, spread over the term. The modeled market-based effective-rent flavor.

marketEffectiveRatePerMonth.description: System-calculated market effective rent expressed per month, derived from the effective-rent calculation result.

marketEffectiveRatePerYear.description: System-calculated market effective rent expressed per year, derived from the effective-rent calculation result.

monetaryUnit.description: Currency unit for all monetary amounts on the deal; normalize to a common currency before aggregating rents or values across deals.

netAggregateValue.description: Total net value of the lease deal over its term (net of concessions); an aggregate deal-value figure used to size the transaction.

noLandlordRepresentative.description: Whether the deal explicitly has no landlord/leasing representative; when true, no landlord rep contacts may be supplied.

noRateEscalation.description: Whether the lease explicitly has no rent escalations; when true, no escalation schedule may be supplied.

noTenantRepresentative.description: Whether the deal explicitly has no tenant representative; when true, no tenant rep contacts may be supplied.

notes.description: Collection of internal research notes/annotations attached to the lease deal record.

numRenewalOption.description: Number of renewal options the tenant holds.

numRenewalOptionComment.description: Free-text comment describing the renewal-option terms.

percentageRent.description: Percentage-rent rate: additional retail rent computed as a percentage of tenant sales above a breakpoint. Displayed as a % on the Lease Comps financial terms.

percentageRentBreakpoint.description: Sales breakpoint above which percentage rent applies; the retail-lease threshold triggering overage rent.

propertyTaxAmount.description: Property-tax amount allocated to the leased space as a tenant occupancy cost, shown on the Lease Comps financial terms ($/SF/Year).

propertyTaxAmountPerYear.description: Annualized property-tax amount for the leased space; per-year form of the tenant's property-tax occupancy cost.

proposalEffectiveRate.description: System-calculated proposal effective rent per square foot from the effective-rent engine, reflecting the proposal-scenario effective rent.

proposalEffectiveRatePerMonth.description: System-calculated proposal effective rent expressed per month, derived from the effective-rent calculation result.

proposalEffectiveRatePerYear.description: System-calculated proposal effective rent expressed per year, derived from the effective-rent calculation result.

purchaseOptionComment.description: Free-text comment describing the purchase-option terms.

purchaseOptionDate.description: Date the tenant may exercise the purchase option.

purchaseOptionPrice.description: Price at which the tenant may buy the property under a purchase option, when the lease has one.

purchaseOptionState.description: Whether the tenant holds an option to purchase the property.

rateActual.description: Actual contract rent rate per square foot negotiated in the lease; the contract rent flavor, distinct from asking and effective.

rateActualIncreaseMethodType.description: Method by which the actual rate increases over the term (escalation method), describing how contract rent steps up.

rateActualPerMonth.description: Actual contract rent expressed as a total per-month amount; mutually exclusive with per-year and per-SF forms, derived when rate is entered.

rateActualPerYear.description: Actual contract rent expressed as a total per-year amount; mutually exclusive with the per-month and per-SF forms, derived when rate is entered.

rateAmountType.description: Code indicating how the actual rate is expressed (per square foot, per month, per year, per seat), governing which rateActual* field carries the value.

rateBasis.description: Time basis (monthly/yearly) of the actual rate, needed to normalize the contract rent to a common $/SF/yr basis.

rateEscalations.description: Collection of contractual rent-escalation steps (bump-ups) over the term; each entry can carry the rate after escalation used in effective-rent math.

renewalOptionDate.description: Date by which or on which the renewal option may be exercised.

renewalOptionState.description: Whether a renewal option exists on the lease.

renewalOptionTermInMonths.description: Length in months of the lease extension granted by exercising the renewal option.

rentPlus.description: Additional rent-plus amount layered on base rent (e.g. TMI = taxes, maintenance, insurance pass-throughs); a supplemental occupancy charge shown alongside CAM/additional rent on the Lease Comps financial terms.

reviewDates.description: Collection of UK rent-review dates at which the contract rent is reset; paired with reviewPatternYears and reviewDatesState.

reviewDatesState.description: For the UK rent-review-dates collection on the lease.

reviewPatternYears.description: UK rent-review cadence in years (interval between contractual rent reviews).

rightOfFirstOfferComment.description: Free-text comment describing the right-of-first-offer terms.

rightOfFirstOfferState.description: Whether the tenant holds a right of first offer on additional/adjacent space.

rightOfFirstRefusalComment.description: Free-text comment describing the right-of-first-refusal terms.

rightOfFirstRefusalSquareFeet.description: Square footage covered by the tenant's right of first refusal on additional space.

rightOfFirstRefusalState.description: Whether the tenant holds a right of first refusal on additional/adjacent space.

serviceChargeAmount.description: Service-charge amount (UK common-area maintenance / building service charge) payable under the lease — an occupancy cost beyond base rent.

serviceChargeAmountPerYear.description: Annualized service-charge amount for the leased space; per-year form of the building service charge.

serviceChargeState.description: For the service-charge (UK CAM-equivalent) figures, indicating whether a service charge is in place, available, or none.

serviceType.description: Rent service type governing who pays operating expenses — e.g. Triple Net (NNN), Full Service, Modified Gross, Industrial Gross, Single/Double Net; UK FRI/IRI/IRO. Resolved from ref.servicetype; required to compare rents on a like basis.

signagePayerType.description: Code identifying who pays for signage under the lease (landlord vs tenant).

signageState.description: Whether the lease grants signage rights to the tenant.

signDate.description: Date the lease was signed by both parties; one of the three key lease dates (sign/commencement/move-in).

sourceTypes.description: Collection of source-type classifications contributing to the deal record, capturing the multiple origins of the deal data.

spaceType.description: Space provenance of the deal (New, Relet, Sublet); drives expiration-date derivation. In leasing-activity terms Direct = relet + new and Sublet = sublet + assignment; product 'Direct' corresponds to Relet.

spaceUse.description: Primary use of the leased space (office, retail, industrial, etc.); gates use-specific fields such as Zone A rent for retail.

spreadOverTermType.description: Code controlling how concessions or rent are spread/amortized over the lease term when computing effective rent.

tenantImprovementAllowancePerSquareFeet.description: Tenant-improvement (TI) allowance per SF the landlord grants for fit-out. A key concession deducted in effective-rent math (NER = base rent less TIA over the term), so a large TIA can push effective rent below base rent.

zoneARent.description: Zone A rent: UK retail rental valuation method pricing the most valuable front-of-shop zone per square foot; only valid when the space use is Retail.

rateLow.description: Low end of the asking rent range.

rateHigh.description: High end of the asking rent range; equal to rateLow when a single rate was quoted.

rateBasis.description: Period the asking rent is quoted for (monthly or yearly).

breakDate.description: Date on which the lease may be broken/early-terminated under this option; key to rollover risk and income-durability analysis.

id.description: Unique identifier of a lease break/termination-option record within a lease deal.

leaseBreakType.description: Code classifying the break-option type (e.g. tenant break, landlord break, mutual), describing who may early-terminate the lease and under what option.

noticePeriodMonths.description: Number of months of advance notice required to exercise the break option before the break date.

terminationPenalty.description: Free-text description of the penalty or fee payable to exercise the early-termination/break option.

concessionAmount.description: Monetary value of the landlord concession (inducement) granted to the tenant; reduces effective rent in lease-economics calculations.

concessionAmountType.description: Unit/basis of the landlord concession amount (e.g. per square foot, total, per month), needed to normalize the inducement's value.

concessionDescription.description: Free-text description of the landlord concession (e.g. moving allowance, fit-out contribution) beyond standard TI and free rent.

id.description: Unique identifier of a landlord-concession record within a lease deal.

contactId.description: Id of the person in CoStar contact data.

contactPhoneNumber.description: Phone number for the lease-deal contact (e.g. broker or party to the deal); personal contact data.

contactPhoneNumberExt.description: Phone extension the contact prefers for discussing the stated space. A non-NULL value overrides the contact's usual phone number; added to accommodate the existing phone-extension naming convention.

contactRole.description: Role of the person or company on this record, such as listing broker, buyer or seller.

locationId.description: The contact's location - the main work location of the contact.

preferredPhoneType.description: Code identifying the contact's preferred phone-number type, such as Contact Phone, Mobile, Fax, Other, or Override.

calendarMonth.description: Calendar month (1-12, where 1=January through 12=December) in which the free rent applies.

calendarYear.description: The calendar year in which the free-rent term applies.

freeRentPercent.description: Percentage of rent that is free (abated) during the scheduled term.

id.description: Primary key enforcing uniqueness of a free-rent schedule entry within a lease deal's concession terms.

intervalMonthCount.description: Number of months over which this free-rent entry recurs/spreads, describing how the abatement is distributed across the term.

leaseMonth.description: The month, counted from when the lease actually began, to which this free-rent term applies.

noteType.description: A pre-defined categorization of note text, typically referred to as 'Notes' in CRM Enterprise.

value.description: The body (free-text content) of the note.

cpiAnnualMaxPercent.description: Cap on the annual CPI-driven rent increase (collar maximum), limiting the bump regardless of how high CPI runs.

cpiAnnualMinPercent.description: Floor on the annual CPI-driven rent increase (collar minimum), guaranteeing a minimum bump regardless of how low CPI runs.

escalationAmount.description: Fixed dollar amount of the rate escalation. Nullable, because when an EscalationPct is specified the escalationAmount may not necessarily apply.

escalationPercent.description: Percentage of the rate escalation. Nullable, because when an escalationAmount is specified the EscalationPct may not necessarily apply.

fromLeaseDate.description: Calendar date on which this escalation step begins, an alternative to fromLeaseMonth for anchoring the bump to an absolute date.

fromLeaseMonth.description: Start of the negotiated term during which the rate escalation applies. A unique constraint on LeaseDealID, RateEscalationTypeID, fromLeaseMonth, and toLeaseMonth prevents multiple rows for the same term on a given lease deal and escalation type.

id.description: Surrogate primary key of the rate-escalation record, added to simplify updating and deleting records.

intervalMonthCount.description: Number of months between recurring applications of this escalation when it repeats, e.g. an annual bump is a 12-month interval.

isRepeatToEnd.description: Whether this escalation step repeats on its interval through the end of the lease term rather than applying just once.

pctOfMarketRate.description: Percentage of prevailing market rent to which rent is reset at this escalation, used for market-rate (fair-market-value) review escalations.

percentOfCpiInputRate.description: Percentage of the Consumer Price Index movement applied as the rent increase for a CPI-indexed escalation, e.g. 80 percent of CPI.

rateActualAfterEscalation.description: Resulting actual contract rent rate after this escalation has been applied; the stepped-up rent figure feeding effective-rent calculations.

rateEscalationAmountType.description: Unit/basis for the escalation amount (e.g. per square foot, per month, total), needed to normalize the bump into a comparable rent figure.

rateEscalationType.description: Code describing if and how the contract rent steps up over the term (escalation method) — e.g. fixed periodic bumps, CPI-indexed, or market-rate reviews. Displayed as a single escalation % with pattern, or 'Varying' for multiple steps.

toLeaseMonth.description: End of the negotiated term during which the rate escalation applies. A unique constraint on LeaseDealID, RateEscalationTypeID, fromLeaseMonth, and toLeaseMonth prevents multiple rows for the same term on a given lease deal and escalation type.

id.description: Unique identifier of a lease review-date record within a lease deal.

leaseReviewType.description: Code classifying the type of scheduled lease review (e.g. rent review / market-rent review), describing the contractual review event.

reviewDate.description: Date of a scheduled lease (rent) review at which contract rent may be reset to market; common in UK leases. Surfaced on the Lease Comps financial terms as a rent-review pattern plus date(s).

buildOut.description: Value describing the build-out type of the occupied space (the nature of the tenant improvements present).

buildOutConditionType.description: Condition of the space's build-out/fit-out (e.g. shell, second-generation, fully built), indicating readiness for occupancy.

buildOutStatus.description: Status of the space build-out (e.g. existing, planned, under construction), describing where the fit-out stands.

id.description: Unique identifier of the occupied-space record representing space taken off-market and physically occupied under a lease.

loadBay.description: Loading-bay attributes of the occupied industrial space (dock/load configuration); a key industrial logistics attribute of the space.

monthsOnMarket.description: Number of months the space was marketed before being taken off-market and occupied; derived from on-market and off-market dates.

propertyFloorId.description: A number uniquely identifying a floor on any property; foreign key locating the occupied space on its floor within the building.

spaceLayout.description: Code describing the physical layout/configuration of the occupied space (e.g. open plan, divided offices).

spacePosition.description: Retail space position (End Cap, In-line, Outparcel/Pad, Anchor, In-Store) describing where the occupied space sits within a center.

squareFeetOccupied.description: Rentable square footage physically occupied in this space; the area driver for occupancy and net/gross absorption measurement. Restricted and suppressed space-for-lease is excluded from aggregate SF.

squareFeetOffice.description: Office portion of the occupied space in square feet. Relevant to industrial/flex office content.

squareFeetUsable.description: Usable (tenant-exclusive) square footage of the occupied space, excluding shared common area; distinct from rentable area.

suite.description: Suite (or unit) number of the occupied space. NULL when the tenant cannot be identified; otherwise derived from the tenant's address. Its data size should match the corresponding field in SpaceForLease, SpaceOccupied, and CondoUnit.

driveInBayState.description: Indicating the presence/availability status of drive-in bays (grade-level doors) for the occupied industrial/flex space.

loadingDockState.description: Indicating the presence/availability status of loading docks for the occupied industrial space; a core logistics loading attribute.

numDriveInBays.description: Count of drive-in bays (grade-level doors a vehicle drives directly through) serving the occupied space; a key loading-access attribute.

numExternalLoadingDocks.description: Count of exterior loading docks serving the occupied space; a key industrial/distribution logistics attribute.

numInternalLoadingDocks.description: Count of interior loading docks serving the occupied space.
